Is Dropcar Inc (NASDAQ:DCAR)’s Fuel Running High? Reports Show Less Sellers Posted by Louis Casey on December 24, 2018 at 5:23 pm
The stock of Dropcar Inc (NASDAQ:DCAR) registered a decrease of 2.24% in short interest. DCAR’s total short interest was 274,600 shares in December as published by FINRA. Its down 2.24% from 280,900 shares, reported previously. With 376,200 shares average volume, it will take short sellers 1 days to cover their DCAR’s short positions. The short interest to Dropcar Inc’s float is 4.77%.
The stock decreased 11.15% or $0.0301 during the last trading session, reaching $0.2399. About 118,787 shares traded. DropCar, Inc. (NASDAQ:DCAR) has declined 92.31% since December 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 92.31% the S&P500.
DropCar, Inc. provides app-based automotive logistics and mobility services for clients and the automotive industry. The company has market cap of $2.33 million. The firm offers Vehicle Support Platform, a cloud platform and mobile app that help clients and automotive-related companies in reducing the cost, hassles, and inefficiencies of owning a car or fleet of cars in urban centers. It currently has negative earnings. The Company’s technology platform blends the efficiency and scale of cloud computing, machine learning, and connected cars with the trained drivers to move cars to/from fully staffed, secure garages to/from the people or businesses who own them.
